termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.intro: By accessing the carzio website, you fully accept these Terms and Conditions.
termsPage.section1Content: Website: refers to the carzio website. User: any person browsing the website or using our services. Provider: carzio, the car rental service provider.
termsPage.section2Content: carzio provides car rental services. Details regarding available vehicles, prices, and specific conditions are available on the website.
termsPage.section3Content: Access to the website is free, while rental services are paid. The User is responsible for their own equipment and internet connection.
termsPage.section4Content: Provide accurate information when making a booking. Comply with the specific rental conditions for each vehicle. Not use the website for illegal purposes.
termsPage.section5Content: Bookings are made through our online platform. Payment is made on key handover by card, including debit cards. No security deposit or card hold is required. A confirmation is sent after booking. The minimum rental is 3 days (72 h). The driver must be at least 23 years old and have held a licence for 4 years. Prices are displayed in euros.
termsPage.section6Content: Cancellation is free up to 24 h before pickup. For later cancellations, contact us on WhatsApp at +212 680 318003 before the pickup time.
termsPage.section7Content: carzio is committed to providing high-quality services but shall not be held responsible for: Misuse of the vehicle. Errors resulting from incorrect information provided by the User.
termsPage.section8Content: We collect and process your data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Your information will never be shared without your consent.
termsPage.section9Content: All website content (texts, images, logos) is the property of carzio. Any reproduction or reuse without prior authorization is prohibited.
termsPage.section10Content: These Terms are governed by Moroccan law. Any disputes shall fall under the jurisdiction of the courts of Agadir.
termsPage.section11Content: carzio reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication on the website.
termsPage.section12Content: In the event of a lost car key, a fee of €150 will be charged. In the event of lost vehicle documents, a fee of €500 will be charged.
termsPage.section13Content: All vehicle reservations submitted through the website are considered availability requests and are not automatically confirmed. The agency reserves the right to review each request and confirm availability before final approval. Customers are required to provide accurate booking information, including their full name, age, email address, phone number, and pickup details. A delivery fee may apply depending on the selected pickup location: Casablanca Mohammed V Airport: €80 per trip. Marrakech-Menara Airport: €80 per trip. Agadir Al Massira Airport: free. Taghazout, Tamraght and Essaouira: on request, price confirmed before booking.
termsPage.section14Content: No security deposit, caution, or guarantee amount shall be required from the customer at the time of booking or vehicle reservation. The customer shall not be obligated to pay, block, or hold any deposit or security amount in connection with the booking of a vehicle, except where expressly stated otherwise in writing by the agency.
termsPage.section15Content: Standard insurance is included in the rental price. It covers the vehicle, including glass, tyres and mirrors. In the event of covered damage, an excess remains your responsibility; its amount is stated in the rental contract signed at key handover. The daily car rental price is the one shown on the car card. The minimum rental is 72 hours, billed in 24-hour blocks; any started block counts as a full day. Cancellation is free up to 24 h before pickup.
termsPage.section16Content: Full Insurance (all-risk) reduces the excess to 0 MAD. It is offered only from 5 billed days: a surcharge of €10 per day when the daily rate is €39 or less, and €15 per day from €40. Rentals are billed in 24-hour blocks; a started block counts as a full day. The option is never pre-selected and is automatically removed when the duration falls below 5 billed days. The exact surcharge is always shown before confirmation.
termsPage.section17Title: 17. Notice — why Full Risk insurance is worth it
termsPage.section17Content: With Standard insurance, in case of damage, an excess of 5,000 MAD or 8,000 MAD remains your responsibility depending on the vehicle. That amount can exceed the total price of your rental. Full Risk insurance covers everything: the excess drops to 0 MAD and, in case of covered damage, nothing remains your responsibility. It costs only €10 or €15 per day depending on the vehicle, and that amount is already included in the total shown before you confirm. For a few euros a day, you drive with complete peace of mind.
